hypothesis: Instruction count is dominated by heapify's linear traversal, its number of internal nodes, and variation in the removed request's position.

pcvs.name: queue_size
pcvs.rationale: Captures linear heap rebuilding and list element shifting after removal.

pcvs.name: heapify_internal_nodes
pcvs.rationale: Counts internal nodes processed by heapify after removing one request.

pcvs.name: target_at_second_slot
pcvs.rationale: Cheap indicator of removal search length and which early heap position is disturbed in this workload.
